description: Install Three.js dependencies and create the ElevenLabs 3D orb component, replacing the old framer-motion orb. This is the foundational dependency — FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on this.
steps: 1. Run `npm install three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei` in frontend/ directory. These are the Three.js ecosystem packages required by the ElevenLabs orb.

2. Create `frontend/src/components/ui/Orb.jsx` — port the ElevenLabs orb from TypeScript to plain JSX. Source: https://github.com/elevenlabs/ui (MIT licensed), file: apps/www/registry/elevenlabs-ui/ui/orb.tsx. Remove all TypeScript type annotations (OrbProps type, AgentState type, typed useRef generics, function parameter types, delta: number annotation). Keep all Three.js logic, GLSL shaders, splitmix32 helper, clamp01, and the full fragment/vertex shader strings intact. The component exports `Orb` as a named export. Props: colors (default ['#CADCFC','#A0B9D1']), colorsRef, resizeDebounce (100), seed, agentState (null), volumeMode ('auto'), manualInput, manualOutput, inputVolumeRef, outputVolumeRef, getInputVolume, getOutputVolume, className. The perlin-noise texture URL (Google CDN) stays as-is — it's a runtime fetch, not a build dependency.
3. Delete the old `frontend/src/components/Orb.jsx` (framer-motion based orb). This file will no longer be imported by anything after FEAT-002 rewires VoiceChat consumers.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/components/ui/Orb.jsx exists and exports a named `Orb` function component

`npm run build` in frontend/ completes with zero errors (the old Orb import in VoiceChat.jsx may cause a build error — if so, temporarily comment out the VoiceChat import in AnalysisPage.jsx or update VoiceChat.jsx to not import the deleted Orb. Ensure the build passes.)
findings: Installed three@latest, @react-three/fiber@8, @react-three/drei@9 (v8/v9 needed for React 18 compat — latest fiber v9 requires React 19). VoiceChat.jsx Orb import and <Orb/> usage commented out and replaced with placeholder div — FEAT-002 must wire the new ui/Orb there. The new Orb uses named export: import { Orb } from './ui/Orb'.
